status: Eight offline native slices complete. Emitted-path readings cover the four returns' current G-code; the four junctions' readings are not yet taken on their current G-code. Physical internal finish and wet service remain unqualified.
scope: One normal object per plate, actual handed source print pose, retained Siraya Tech Flex TPU85A Clear right0.6 recipe. No printer was contacted or launched. These manual readings do not join the normal CAD/build path.

mesh_scope.definition: The native project contains its separately hashed source-native preparation mesh; it is not byte-identical to the finer canonical download STL. Emitted-path proof binds the actual project, body and wet-void STL hashes above.

wet_support_exclusion: Actual wet-cavity vertical projection plus0.65mmXY allowance, Z−2 to body top+2; local wet-shadow support exclusion only. External Tree(auto)/Default retained.

reading_method.support: Actual positive-extrusion support-bead XY footprints use emitted widths and heights and are compared with closed wet-void mesh sections at three heights through every support layer. Zero sampled overlap is a sampled deposition result, not an unconditional tree-transit or support-removal claim.
reading_method.first_layers: Complete native model, brim and support footprints at the first two actual layer heights. Overlap is geometric attachment opportunity, not measured bed adhesion.
reading_method.lower_stop: Actual posed lower mouth/tube-stop points determine layer selection. First six post-stop layers are read in emission order against previous-layer and already-placed same-layer bead footprints. Centerline spacing is at most0.10mm; nominal reach subtracts0.05mm for unsampled distance. It does not measure deposited TPU adhesion or strength.
reading_method.travel: Actual nonextruding3D nozzle segments and last-positive-extrusion-attachment to each nozzle-waypoint taut chords are intersected with the actual translated watertight wet-void STL. Arcs are sampled at most0.05mm; crossings at most0.10mm are omitted from opportunity counts. The chord is a possible free strand, not a prediction of extrusion, sag or contamination. Startup before first object extrusion and terminal travel after last object extrusion are outside this reading.

limits: The four junction projects' support, first/second-layer, bed-margin, nonextruding-travel and lower-stop readings are not taken on their current G-code; read them before a junction print.
Nonextruding nozzle and possible taut-chord crossings remain in the emitted G-code. Single-object placement and saved travel-avoidance settings do not establish clean wet passages.

No physical print or acceptance exists for these eight bodies. Bore finish, accessible exterior-support release, bed adhesion, food contact, seal forces, pressure retention, inserted-tube capture and service life are not qualified by these readings.
Estimates include the native plate output with its automatic support/brim decisions. They are slicer predictions, not measured production consumption or machine time.
